an8.22:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati hatthigāme.
an8.22:1.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethāti.
an8.22:1.5: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an8.22:2.1: athakho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.22:2.2: athakho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca
an8.22:2.3: aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ gahapati acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato
an8.22:2.4: katame te gahapati aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā yehi tvaṃ samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti.
an8.22:3.2: katamehi aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato
an8.22:3.3: api ca bhante ye me aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā saṃvijjanti
an8.22:3.4: te suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti.
an8.22:3.5: evaṃ gahapatīti kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa paccassosi.
an8.22:3.7: yadāhaṃ bhante nāgavane paricaranto bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūratova addasaṃ
an8.22:3.8: saha dassaneneva me bhante bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi surāmado ca pahiyyi
an8.22:3.9: ayaṃ kho me bhante paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:4.1: so kho ahaṃ bhante pasannacitto bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ
an8.22:4.2: tassa me bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyathīdaṃ
an8.22:4.3: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi
an8.22:4.4: yadā maṃ bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
an8.22:4.6: seyyathāpi nāma suddhavatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya
an8.22:4.7: evameva kho me tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
an8.22:4.9: so kho ahaṃ bhante diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane tattheva buddhañca dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādayiṃ
an8.22:4.10: ayaṃ kho me bhante dutiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:5.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ
an8.22:5.2: athakhvāhaṃ bhante yena tā pajāpatiyo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etadavocaṃ
an8.22:5.3: mayā kho bhaginiyo brahmacariyapañcamāni sikkhāpadāni samādinnāni
an8.22:5.4: yā icchati sā imeva bhoge bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu
an8.22:5.5: hoti vā pana purisādhippāyo kassa vo dammīti
an8.22:5.6: evaṃ vutte sā bhante jeṭṭhā pajāpati maṃ etadavoca
an8.22:5.8: athakho ahaṃ bhante taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa oṇojesiṃ
an8.22:5.9: komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante dānaṃ pariccajanto nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ
an8.22:5.10: ayaṃ kho me bhante tatiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:6.1: saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante kule bhogā
an8.22:6.2: te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi
an8.22:6.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante catuttho acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:7.1: yaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante bhikkhuṃ payirupāsāmi
an8.22:7.3: so ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ desesi
an8.22:7.5: no ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ desesi ahamassa dhammaṃ desemi
an8.22:7.6: ayaṃ kho me bhante pañcamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:8.1: anacchariyaṃ kho pana me bhante saṅghe nimantite devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti
an8.22:8.2: asoko gahapati bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto asoko paññāvimutto asoko kāyasakkhi asoko diṭṭhippatto asoko saddhāvimutto asoko dhammānusārī asoko saddhānusārī asoko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo asoko dussīlo pāpadhammoti
an8.22:8.3: saṅghaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante parivisanto nābhijānāmi evaṃ cittaṃ uppādento
an8.22:8.4: imassa vā thokaṃ demi imassa vā bahukanti
an8.22:8.6: ayaṃ kho me bhante chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:9.1: anacchariyaṃ kho pana maṃ bhante devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti
an8.22:9.3: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante tā devatā evaṃ vadāmi
an8.22:9.4: vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devate no vā vadeyyātha athakho svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammoti
an8.22:9.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhante abhijānāmi tatonidānaṃ cittassa uṇṇanti
an8.22:9.6: maṃ vā devatā upasaṅkamanti ahaṃ vā devatāhi saddhiṃ sallapāmi
an8.22:9.7: ayaṃ kho me bhante sattamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:10.1: sace kho panāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā paṭhamataraṃ kālaṃ kareyyaṃ anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ yammaṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyya
an8.22:10.2: natthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto uggo gahapati hatthigāmako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyāti
an8.22:10.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.22:11.1: ime kho bhante aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā saṃvijjanti
an8.22:11.3: katamehi cāhaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti.
an8.22:12.1: athakho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi
an8.22:12.2: athakho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi
an8.22:12.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu yāvatako ahosi uggena gahapatinā hatthigāmakena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an8.22:13.2: yathā taṃ uggo gahapati hatthigāmako sammā byākaramāno byākareyya imeheva kho bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato uggo gahapati hatthigāmako mayā byākato
an8.22:13.3: imehi ca pana bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethāti. 23
